look.photo: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a teenager in Vyshenky, a village near Kyiv on a bay of the Dnipro river, late October. Ordinary phone camera: natural or available light, slight noise and softness, casual off-centre framing, nothing staged, cinematic or glossy. Fictional people only, no recognisable brands or logos, no readable text unless the brief asks for it.

ch01-mom.shows: Оля доказывает алиби скрином переписки с мамой — но время на скрине обрезано, проверить, когда пришло «ты где?», нельзя.
ch01-mom.clue: нет ни часов сверху, ни времени у сообщений — скрин подозрительно обрезан

ch04-microsd.shows: Оля нашла в кармане своей куртки чужую карту памяти и показывает её на ладони.

ch04-microsd.prompt: Close-up phone photo looking down at the open left palm of a teenage girl, fingers slightly curled, a chipped dark nail polish. In the middle of the palm lies one tiny black microSD memory card, about the size of a fingernail, its gold contacts catching the light. Behind the hand, out of focus: the dark sleeve of a padded jacket and a dim bedroom floor. Warm light from a single bedside lamp from the left, deep shadows, slight motion blur, grainy evening phone photo.

boxes.desc: an open teenage girl's palm, fingers slightly curled, warm lamp light
one tiny black microSD card with gold contacts lying in the centre of the palm

ch04-microsd.note: s1, s2 — карта похожа на плату с деталями; s3 — ряд контактов у короткого края, читается как microSD. Карта крупнее настоящей (≈ ноготь) — в пузыре это помогает.

ch04-diary.prompt: Phone photo taken from above of an open spiral-bound school notebook lying on a wooden desk. The right-hand page is lined paper, slightly creased, with a faint coffee ring in the corner; the upper half of the page is blank, no writing at all. The left page is turned away and out of focus. A ballpoint pen lies across the bottom edge. Cool grey daylight from a window on the left, soft shadow of the spiral, slightly tilted framing.

ch05-frame1.shows: Первый кадр видео с карты памяти: ночь два года назад, свет телефона, Денис стоит на уступе над водой карьера.
ch05-frame1.clue: одинокая фигура мальчика на краю уступа, под ним чёрная вода
ch05-frame1.prompt: A dark, grainy frame from a shaky phone video filmed at night inside an old flooded stone quarry. The camera stands on the quarry rim and looks across at a high rock ledge jutting out from the sheer quarry wall: a vertical drop of many metres of bare grey rock below the ledge, and far below, at the bottom of the frame, black still water. On the very tip of the high ledge stands a thin fifteen-year-old boy in a t-shirt and shorts, seen from the side, arms slightly out for balance, looking down at the water. The harsh white beam of a phone torch from behind the camera lights the ledge and the boy; the rest fades into darkness. Heavy digital noise, motion blur, blown-out highlights, crushed blacks, a low-quality phone video still from a few years ago.

boxes.desc: the tip of a high rock ledge jutting out from a sheer quarry wall, lit by a phone torch
a thin fifteen-year-old boy standing on the tip of the ledge, seen from the side, arms slightly out
a sheer vertical drop of bare grey rock wall below the ledge
black still water far below at the bottom of the quarry

ch05-frame1.note: попытка 1 (сиды 1–3): мальчик на плоском камне у самой воды — нет высоты. Попытка 2: уступ высоко в стене карьера, обрыв и вода внизу рамками. Выбран s4: край уступа, обрыв и вода внизу читаются; s5, s6 — уступ как площадка, меньше напряжения

ch05-frame2.shows: Второй кадр: тот же уступ, сбоку у куста — Оля и Костя, лица видно. Оля этого и боится: она в кадре.
ch05-frame2.clue: два подростка сбоку у куста, лица в свете телефона
ch05-frame2.prompt: The same dark grainy night phone video frame of the same flooded quarry, the same high rock ledge jutting out of the sheer quarry wall, the same harsh phone torch light from behind the camera, the same black water far below. Change only this: the boy is gone from the tip of the ledge, and on the quarry rim at the upper left, beside a dark bush, stand two young teenagers close together — a girl with long hair in a hoodie and a boy in a dark jacket — their faces lit white by the torch, looking towards the edge. Keep the same camera angle, the same rock wall and drop, the same heavy noise and motion blur of a cheap phone video. Nobody else in the frame.

boxes.desc: a girl in a hoodie and a boy in a dark jacket standing close together on the quarry rim beside a dark bush, faces lit white by a phone torch
a dark bush on the quarry rim

ch05-frame2.note: референс ch05-frame1 держит место во всех трёх. s2 отклонён: за подростками лишняя пара ног — третий человек в кадре, спойлер; s1 — у мальчика в руке фонарь, путает, кто снимает; s3 — двое у куста, чисто

ch05-frame3.shows: Третий кадр: почти чёрный экран — камера опущена, только голоса. Игрок понимает, что главное на записи не видно, а слышно.
ch05-frame3.clue: почти чёрный кадр, лишь серая кромка камня и блик
ch05-frame3.prompt: An almost completely black frame from a phone video recorded at night: the camera is pointing at the ground and moving. Only a faint grey streak of rock at the lower edge and a small smeared highlight of a phone torch are visible; everything else is pure black with heavy digital noise and motion blur. No people visible.
ch05-frame3.note: s3 — почти чёрный кадр, серая кромка камня и размытый блик; s1, s2 тоже годятся, s3 темнее

ch08-phone.prompt: Night phone photo taken with the flash, looking down at rough grey stones at the foot of old stone steps by a quarry. In the centre lies a smartphone inside a clear plastic waterproof pouch for rowing, with a bright neon-green lanyard cord coiled beside it. The phone's black screen is shattered with a spiderweb of cracks visible through the clear plastic. Wet stones, a few dry leaves, harsh flash light falling off into darkness at the edges.
